task.title: P6-039: Collapse the four "owned" definitions in hosted.rs onto one shared source
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 1 — Destructive actions and data integrity). Original id: P6-039. Size: S. Specs: specs/collection-api.md.

Four definitions of "owned" live in hosted.rs, they agree today, and nothing enforces that they continue to (rescoped 2026-07-30 — the entry said three). The owned_by_card view at :100 (shared by search and card_summary), all_cards' inline held CTE at :1274, collection_tree's shopping_short o CTE at :417, and shopping_list's o CTE at :1458. Collapse onto one shared source, and add a test that asserts they agree.

Do this first: it is the prerequisite of the whole deletion chain (P6-110 → P6-188 → P6-189 → P6-190). Soft delete requires every one of them to grow a deleted_at IS NULL filter, and adding it to four places and missing one produces owned counts that silently disagree between the catalog, /my, the tree and the shopping list — a bug with no error and no failing test. Collapsing first means the filter is added once.
